description: Image dimensions, thumbnails and RAW previews in the browser on a worker pool, with opt-in decoders for camera RAW, HEIC, TIFF and PSD.
rules: Create one createImageFast() instance per app and reuse it. Create it in browser-only code, after mount when rendering on the server.
Use dimensions(file) to read width and height: it parses the file header without decoding. Do not decode an image just to measure it.
RAW, HEIC, TIFF and PSD need their plugin: import { raw } from 'imagefast/raw' (or /heic, /tiff, /psd) and pass createImageFast({ plugins: [raw] }).
Calls reject with an ImageFastError. Branch on error.code ('no-decoder', 'decode-failed', 'aborted', 'terminated', 'worker-crashed'), not on the message.
Pass { signal } to cancel a call. AbortSignal.timeout(ms) makes a timeout.
Close the ImageBitmap returned by bitmap() after drawing it, and revoke object URLs created from thumbnail blobs.
RAW files are detected by file name or MIME type: pass a File, or a Blob with a type.
imagefast is ESM only and runs in browsers only (Chrome and Edge 94+, Firefox 114+, Safari 17+). On a server, use sharp.
